content.title: The Consumer Is Cracking. These 2 Airline Stocks Can Handle It, BofA Says.
content.summary: Americans are nervous about the economy, and that concern is weighing on consumer stocks.  While the stock market may be close to record highs, American consumers have plenty to be anxious about, including lingering inflation, tariffs, and the ongoing government shutdown—not to mention the possibility that artificial intelligence may be coming for their jobs.  The University of Michigan’s consumer sentiment index clocked in at 55.1 for the first two weeks of October, below the expectations of economists tracked by  FactSet  The reading wasn’t much better than it was in the summer of 2022 when inflation spiked, or the in early 2010s following the global financial crisis.
